title: Enterprise RAG Semantic Search & Hallucination Verification Engine with FastAPI, pgvector & Sentence-Transformers
problem: Enterprise retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications frequently generate plausible-sounding hallucinations, quote non-existent policy clauses, and expose internal knowledge bases to context-stuffing vulnerabilities. Naive vector retrieval relying solely on dense similarity returns irrelevant chunks when users query specific entity IDs, keyword codes, or acronyms, degrading answer quality. This project builds a production-grade enterprise RAG semantic search and verification engine in Python. The system ingests technical documentation, generates dense vector representations with open-source Sentence-Transformers, stores and indexes chunks using PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension (HNSW indexing), performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), synthesizes answers with local LLMs, and verifies generated claims using automated citation verification.

use_cases.title: Enterprise IT Policy & Compliance QA Assistant
use_cases.first_sentence: Enterprise employees querying internal security policy handbooks need exact policy answers with verifiable paragraph citations rather than generic advice.
use_cases.second_sentence: The engine retrieves top relevant policy chunks using hybrid vector search, synthesizes a grounded response via FastAPI, and highlights exact sentence citations matching source documents.

use_cases.title: Engineering Technical Architecture Specification Retrieval
use_cases.first_sentence: Software engineering teams navigating large system architecture repositories need to query API contract specifications and database schemas.
use_cases.second_sentence: The RAG backend combines pgvector semantic similarity with keyword matching to retrieve accurate technical snippets, reducing developer search time from hours to seconds.

use_cases.title: Customer Support Agent Troubleshooting Copilot
use_cases.first_sentence: Support engineers handling complex hardware troubleshooting tickets require fast access to relevant diagnostic flowcharts and error resolution manuals.
use_cases.second_sentence: The system matches incoming customer error logs to service manual chunks, generating step-by-step diagnostic workflows verified against official manuals.

hard_parts: Implementing hybrid dense-sparse retrieval combining pgvector HNSW cosine similarity with PostgreSQL full-text search (tsvector) using Reciprocal Rank Fusion
Designing semantic chunking pipelines that preserve document hierarchical context without fragmenting code blocks or structured tables
Building an automated claim-level hallucination verification module that cross-checks generated sentences against retrieved source chunk spans
Optimizing pgvector HNSW index parameters (m, ef_construction, ef_search) to achieve sub-25ms retrieval latency across 100,000 document chunks
screener_signals: Clean Python codebase cleanly separating document chunkers, pgvector database adapters, embedding generators, and verification endpoints
Search latency and accuracy report proving sub-25ms p95 vector retrieval and >= 88% Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR@10) on technical queries

Anti-fake verification script submitting an adversarial ungrounded question (querying non-existent policy XYZ-999) and asserting the engine responds with 'INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT' rather than hallucinating

architecture.data_flow: Documents ingest into the pipeline; the chunker splits content into 500-token chunks with 50-token overlap; Sentence-Transformers computes 384-d embeddings; chunks and vectors insert into PostgreSQL; pgvector maintains the HNSW index; a user submits a query via FastAPI; the query converts to an embedding and a tsquery; pgvector executes hybrid dense-sparse search and merges results using Reciprocal Rank Fusion; top-5 chunks assemble into a prompt context; the generation module synthesizes an answer; the citation verifier validates extracted claim spans against source chunk text; the response returns with verified citation badges.
architecture.enforcement_mechanism: Strict cosine distance similarity thresholds and citation verification algorithms rejecting ungrounded claims.

prerequisites: Proficiency in Python backend development, FastAPI, and relational database interactions (SQLAlchemy / asyncpg)
Understanding of vector search concepts (embeddings, cosine similarity, HNSW indexing) and RAG architecture principles

environment.gpu: None required (compact Sentence-Transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding model runs efficiently on CPU)
environment.cost: $0 (fully open-source stack using local PostgreSQL with pgvector in Docker)
environment.accounts_keys_quotas: No external cloud accounts, paid services, or API keys required (uses open-source local embeddings and local QA synthesis)
environment.reference_environment: Local 4-core CPU with Docker Desktop (pgvector container) and Python 3.11 with PyTorch CPU
environment.fallback_path: Local SQLite vector extension or in-memory NumPy cosine similarity matrix if Docker pgvector is unavailable

riskiest_component.name: HNSW Vector Index Saturation and Out-of-Domain Hallucinations
riskiest_component.mitigation: Tune HNSW ef_construction and m parameters for high recall, and enforce similarity distance cutoffs that trigger INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT.
riskiest_component.fallback: Exact flat cosine distance scan (ivfflat or sequential scan) for datasets under 20,000 chunks.
